about: Tricky cases for the junk bake-off (assistant-authored synthetic, written 2026-11-03 before any candidate was run on it; never trained on). Same invented user as modern-dev.json (Contoso; contacts Daniel Kim, Priya Raman, Hannah Okafor, Maya Chen, Marcus Lee). Wanted mail that is easy to misfile (code-only subjects from suppliers and family, urgent bare attachments from strangers, a security code, a password reset you asked for, Spanish), and unwanted mail in the style of real attachment lures, reworded scams, a look-alike name, an image-only message and an instruction aimed at AI filters. Labels are the author's.
